author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Adventure Time might look like a silly cartoon about a boy and his magical dog, but underneath all the colorful randomness was one of the most surprisingly mature animated shows of its generation.

Over the course of 10 seasons, Adventure Time evolved from a goofy Cartoon Network comedy into something much more ambitious. It explored grief, trauma, abandonment, family, growing up, and the complicated relationships that make us who we are. And somehow, it managed to do all of this without losing the absurd humor and imagination that made it special in the first place.

But there was one episode that changed everything...

From its humble beginnings to its emotional highs, we're looking back at how Adventure Time grew alongside its audience and became one of the most memorable animated shows of its generation.

title: Was Adventure Time ACTUALLY Made For Kids?
